verdict.rationale: Mastra documents event-triggered workflow runs, recurring schedules, and routing of webhook or polling events into notification signals. None of the evidence mentions debouncing, batching, delaying, or otherwise collapsing noisy triggers. Plain triggering and scheduling are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I debounce, batch, or delay triggers so noisy event streams collapse into the runs I actually want
